workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the slots where both are free (30-min meeting):

- Monday: 09:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

Can you check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars for these slots and let me know which times work for all four?

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison. I've checked Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars against the slots you provided. Unfortunately, NONE of the slots where Priya and Marcus are free also work for both Elena and David.

Here's why each slot doesn't work:
- Monday 09:00-10:00: Elena busy 09:00-10:00, David busy 09:00-10:00
- Tuesday 13:00-14:00: Elena busy 13:00-14:00, David busy 13:00-14:00
- Tuesday 16:30-17:00: Elena busy 16:30-17:00, David busy 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday 15:00-16:00: David busy 15:00-16:00
- Thursday 10:00-10:30: Elena busy 10:00-10:30
- Friday 11:00-12:00: Elena busy 11:00-12:00, David busy 11:00-12:00

Here are the slots where BOTH Elena and David are free:
- Monday: 11:00-12:00
- Tuesday: 09:00-10:00
- Wednesday: 13:00-14:00
- Thursday: 09:30-10:00, 14:30-15:30
- Friday: 15:00-16:00

Can you check Priya and Marcus's calendars for these slots? We need to find any overlap.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've cross-referenced your list of slots where Elena and David are both free against Priya and Marcus's calendars. Unfortunately, there's NO overlap at all:

- Monday 11:00-12:00 (E&D free): Priya busy 11:00-11:30 Travel, 11:30-12:00 Contract review
- Tuesday 09:00-10:00 (E&D free): Priya busy 09:00-09:30 Board prep, 09:30-10:00 Partner lunch
- Wednesday 13:00-14:00 (E&D free): Priya busy 13:00-13:30 Client call, 13:30-14:00 Client dinner prep
- Thursday 09:30-10:00 (E&D free): Priya busy 09:30-10:00
- Thursday 14:30-15:30 (E&D free): Priya busy 14:30-15:00 Contract review, 15:00-15:30 Board prep
- Friday 15:00-16:00 (E&D free): Priya busy 15:00-15:30 Hiring panel, 15:30-16:00 Contract review

None of these work for Priya (and Marcus is also busy at some of these times).

Could you please double-check Elena and David's calendars to make sure you haven't missed any slots? Specifically, can you check if either Elena or David is free during:
- Monday 09:00-10:00
- Tuesday 13:00-14:00 or 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday 15:00-16:00
- Thursday 10:00-10:30
- Friday 11:00-12:00

These are the only times Priya and Marcus are both available. If neither Elena nor David is free during any of these, then the meeting cannot be scheduled.
